title: GTK-Apps icons are not visible in the global menu
line: Global Menu now shows the icons GTK apps put on their menu items.
explanation: GTK apps export menu item icons as a serialized GIcon, e.g. ('themed', ['layer-raise', ...]). The GMenu-to-DBusMenu proxy read that value with toString(), which is always empty for a struct, and then overwrote it unconditionally with an icon looked up from its own table of action names, so only items whose action name happened to be in that table ever got an icon. The proxy now reads the themed icon name from the GIcon and uses the action name table only when the app gave no icon.

commits.message:
gmenu-dbusmenu-proxy: Show the icons GTK apps set on menu items

GTK sends item icons as a serialized GIcon, which we read as an empty
string and then replaced with our own action name icon anyway. Read the
themed icon name and only use the action name table as a fallback.

BUG: 436463

media.caption: Pure master: a GTK3 app's File menu items (themed icons document-open, layer-raise, application-exit) show no icons in the Global Menu
With the fix: the same items show the app's icons

review.text: The root cause and layer are right (demarshaling GTK's serialized GIcon and stopping the unconditional overwrite by Icons::actionIcon), and the QDBusArgument parsing is safe. However, unconditionally returning names.value(0) ignores the rest of GThemedIcon's fallback list and skips Icons::actionIcon even when names[0] does not exist in the active icon theme, which can leave items iconless or regress standard action icons.
changes: Iterate through the themed GIcon names list and pick the first icon name where QIcon::hasThemeIcon(name) is true instead of blindly returning names.value(0).

Only let an app-provided icon (whether plain QString or themed GIcon) override Icons::actionIcon(actionName) if QIcon::hasThemeIcon() succeeds, so nonexistent or app-private icon names still fall back to the action-name icon table rather than regressing to no icon.

reviews.text: Root cause is right and in the right place: the proxy read the serialized GIcon ('themed', <as>) with toString(), which is always empty, and then overwrote the result with Icons::actionIcon() unconditionally. The fix demarshals the (sv) struct, takes the themed name and keeps the action-name table only as a fallback, which is exactly what c1's D-Bus dump needs; the after shot shows app-set icons on items the table doesn't know. Nit: GTK sends a fallback list (e.g. ['layer-raise','layer','layer-raise-symbolic',…]) and only the first name is used, so picking the first name for which QIcon::hasThemeIcon() is true would show icons in more cases; file/bytes GIcons stay unsupported, as the notes say.
